body: As skin changes, the answer is usually better choices, not more of them.

slides.h: Why does your skin change in your 40s?

Hormones shift.
So does your skin.

Drier. More sensitive.
Slower to settle.
body: Common things women notice around perimenopause.

slides.h:
Nothing’s gone wrong.
Your skin’s needs have changed.
Let’s work out what yours needs now.
What actually happens in a skin consultation?
body: Twenty minutes. Here’s how they go.

slides.h: We start with you.
body: A short questionnaire about your skin, your routine and anything you’ve noticed lately.

slides.h: Then we look at your skin.
body: A close look, with us talking you through what we see as we go.

slides.h: We talk about what you’d like.
body: What you’d like to change, what you’d rather leave alone, and what fits your life.

slides.h: You leave with a plan.
body: A treatment, products or simply a better routine. What you do next is up to you.

Sun, sleep, stress.
What your skin notices first.
In Queensland, UV is 3 or above all year.
body: That’s the level where sun protection is recommended, even in winter.

slides.h: Short nights tend to show.
body: Dullness and puffiness are common after a run of poor sleep.

slides.h: Hard weeks can show up on your skin too.
body: Breakouts and sensitivity are things people often notice.
